name: fetch-egress
description: Deterministic egress control for the fetch server. Three independent layers: (1) https only, to a short host allowlist; (2) at most 64 characters of query string, so a URL cannot carry a long payload in its query (the path is not covered); (3) every outbound argument is scanned for secret-shaped tokens and for hashes of data this session read through any other boundary (shared taint store).
